note: simple_megamenu_example is a starter-kit submodule of simple_megamenu. On install it ships (config/install) a simple_mega_menu_type bundle 'megamenu' (label MegaMenu, targetMenu main), five fields on the simple_mega_menu 'megamenu' bundle (field_image image, field_image_link link, field_image_title string, field_text text_long, field_links link), an image style 'simple_megamenu', before/after/default displays, and a simple-mega-menu--megamenu.html.twig template. It has no configure route, permissions, plugins or Drush. Cases are grounded in that shipped config and the parent entity storage.

evals.prompt: What does the simple_megamenu_example submodule give you when you enable it on a Drupal site?
evals.expected_output: It installs a ready-made 'megamenu' Simple mega menu type (bundle) with example image/link/text fields, before/after view modes, an image style and a template - a working starting example you can copy and adapt.

evals.prompt: Which example fields does the simple_megamenu_example 'megamenu' bundle ship for building a mega menu?
evals.expected_output: The megamenu bundle ships field_image (image), field_image_link (link), field_image_title (string), field_text (text_long) and field_links (link).

evals.prompt: Out of the box, which menu is the simple_megamenu_example 'megamenu' bundle configured to apply to?
evals.expected_output: The megamenu bundle's targetMenu is set to the 'main' (Main navigation) menu.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the simple_megamenu_example 'megamenu' bundle is installed. Inspect the live configuration and name at least two fields defined on that mega menu bundle.
evals.expected_output: The megamenu bundle has field_image, field_image_link, field_image_title, field_text and field_links. Discover via field config, e.g. drush cget field.field.simple_mega_menu.megamenu.field_image or the Manage fields page.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, use the example 'megamenu' mega menu type to create a new Simple mega menu entity named exactly 'Example Promo', and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create a simple_mega_menu entity with type 'megamenu' and name 'Example Promo' (via /admin/content/simple_mega_menu/add/megamenu or SimpleMegaMenu::create(['type' => 'megamenu', 'name' => 'Example Promo'])->save()).
